description: Static onboarding guide for connecting local LLMs to MMIR.ai through the hardened MMIR Local Node.

steps.title: Install local connector
steps.description: Run the MMIR Local Node installer from the local-node project. It checks Node.js, detects Ollama, recommends a starter model and keeps the connector bound to localhost by default.

steps.title: Detect local models
steps.description: The connector discovers Ollama models and returns them through the MMIR /models contract with safe metadata and hardware guidance.

steps.title: Pair with MMIR.ai
steps.description: The frontend pairs with the local connector before model/chat control. It stores only the local connector URL, session token and safe profile metadata.

steps.title: Chat safely
steps.description: MMIR routes chat requests through /chat/completions. Raw Ollama port 11434 should not be exposed publicly.

security: No secrets in GitHub Pages frontend
Local connector requires pairing before model and chat routes
Allow users to disconnect and delete local profiles
